title: Packers' Josh Jacobs released from jail but still might face charges over alleged weekend incident

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Packers' Josh Jacobs released from jail but still might face charges over alleged weekend incident
sources.description: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs has been released from a Wisconsin jail a day after being arrested in relation to an alleged weekend incident. He still could face criminal charges.
